items.title: Zanana tolidi chakkar - menstrual cycle (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of the menstrual cycle (PDF 79-82).

blocks.text: Zanana tolidi nizam chakkar daar waqiat, yaani menstrual cycle, se kaam karta hai jo taqreeban aik mahina (ausat 28 din) chalta aur teen marahil rakhta hai.

items: Menstrual phase (din 1 se 5): endometrium ki functional teh jharti aur tissue aur khoon 3 se 5 din jism se bahar aate hain (haiz), kyunke estrogen aur progesterone kam hote hain. FSH barhna shuru hota hai.

Proliferative phase aur ovulation (din 6 se 14): FSH barhne se chand follicles barhte magar sirf aik, Graafian follicle, pak kar ovary ki sateh par aata aur baqi khatam ho jate hain. FSH is se estrogen chhurwata hai jo endometrium dobara bana kar makhmali, mota aur khoon wala karta hai. Is marhale ke aakhir (din 14) mein anterior pituitary se LH ka achanak ikhraj Graafian follicle se ovum oviduct mein chhurwata hai: ovulation.

Secretory (post-ovulatory) phase (din 15 se 28): LH phate follicle ko peela corpus luteum banata jo estrogen aur progesterone chhorta, jis se endometrium zyada khoon wala aur glandular hota. Fertilization na ho to corpus luteum khatam hota, LH ruk jata, estrogen aur progesterone achanak girte aur moti endometrium khoon ke saath jharti hai: din 28 par haiz.

blocks.alt: Din 1 se 28 ka chart. Oopar: follicles barh kar Graafian follicle, din 14 par ovulation, phir corpus luteum jo barh kar toot jata. Beech: FSH kam aur thore ubhaar, din 14 se zara pehle LH ka tez ubhaar, estrogen ovulation se pehle aur baad mein bulandi par, aur progesterone doosre hisse mein zyada. Neeche: rahim ki teh, din 1 se 5 tak jharti, din 14 tak moti hoti aur secretory phase mein sab se moti.
blocks.caption: Menstrual cycle mein ovary, hormones aur rahim ki tabdeeliyan (Figures 17.6 aur 17.7 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: Menstrual phase (din 1 se 5): kam estrogen aur progesterone se endometrium ki functional teh khoon ke saath jharti hai; FSH barhna shuru hota hai. Proliferative phase aur ovulation (din 6 se 14): FSH se chand follicles barhte, aik Graafian follicle banta jis ka estrogen endometrium dobara banata; din 14 ke qareeb LH ka achanak ikhraj Graafian follicle se anda chhurwata hai. Secretory phase (din 15 se 28): LH phate follicle ko corpus luteum banata jis ka estrogen aur progesterone endometrium ko zyada khoon wala aur glandular banate; fertilization na ho to corpus luteum toot'ta, hormones girte aur haiz phir shuru hota hai.

blocks.title: Hamal aur menopause
blocks.text: Agar anda fertilize ho jaye to nanha janeen human chorionic gonadotropin (hCG) chhorta hai jo corpus luteum ko zinda rakhta, to estrogen aur progesterone zyada rehte aur haiz ruk jata hai; hCG maa ke bajaye janeen ke chorion se aata hai, is liye hamal ke test isi hormone ko pakarte hain. Taqreeban 50 saal ki umar mein chakkar band ho jate hain: menopause.

blocks.title: Matan ke baare mein
blocks.text: Kitab kehti hai estrogen barhne par FSH girta hai is liye LH chhoot'ta hai. Zyada tar hawalon ke mutabiq ovulation se zara pehle estrogen ki zyada aur musalsal satah hi LH ka ubhaar laati hai (pituitary par positive feedback), aur saath FSH ka chhota ubhaar hota hai. Khaaka yahi aam namoona dikhata hai.

blocks.prompt: Corpus luteum ka kirdar kya hai, aur hamal mein ise kya zinda rakhta hai?
blocks.explanation: Yeh estrogen aur progesterone chhorta hai jo endometrium ko mota, khoon wala aur glandular rakhte hain. Hamal mein janeen ka hCG ise qaim rakhta hai, to teh nahi jharti.

items: Din 1-5 haiz (kam estrogen, progesterone); 6-14 FSH, Graafian follicle, estrogen, LH ubhaar aur ovulation; 15-28 corpus luteum, progesterone; fertilization nahi: hormones girte, chakkar dobara.
Janeen ka hCG corpus luteum ko qaim rakhta; taqreeban 50 par menopause.
